Title: GitPython: Arbitrary file truncation via git rev-list --output argument injection in unguarded Commit.count
Description: `Commit.count()` forwards `**kwargs` into `rev_list` with **no** `check_unsafe_options` guard (the guard exists only in the sibling `iter_items`, commit.py:341). `git rev-list --output=<path>` opens and truncates the target file to 0 bytes before revision parsing, so `count(output='/victim')` destroys/blanks an arbitrary file.
